corrections: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent fighting-game sprite sheet matching exactly the silver-haired bearded slim-average Fausto from reference1, with reference2 for his samurai outfit. FOUR equal columns THREE equal rows, 12 full body sprites facing RIGHT, identical body size and floor baseline within each row, generous empty transparent gaps, no background no ground symbols no text no mist baked in. Row1 black suit white shirt navy tie black shoes. Row2 oversized black T-shirt blue jeans white sneakers. Row3 full dark samurai armor hakama sandals, sword SHEATHED. EACH ROW SAME FOUR POSES: column1 standing leaning head slightly forward BOTH HANDS clearly on TOP of head fingers ruffling hair elbows lifted outward; column2 same pose but BOTH HANDS shifted rubbing/ruffling sides and crown of hair with different elbow positions, creating an obvious two-frame hair-rubbing animation; column3 boxer heavy punch windup BOTH clenched fists in FRONT of body, one fist guarding cheek and other drawn back beside chest, NEVER behind back; column4 strong straight heavy punch toward right with one fist fully extended and other fist held up directly at cheek in guard, both arms visible FRONT of torso. For samurai row columns3/4 can be neutral sheathed sword guard. Preserve face and youthful silver-haired appearance; no exaggerated musculature. Match crisp hand-painted pixel fighter style and outlined shading from references. All feet entirely visible. Exact 4x3 grid.
